# Napnix (Napix)

> Napnix — also commonly searched as Napix — is an India-based software development company building custom web applications, mobile apps, cloud infrastructure, AI/ML solutions, NapCRM, and NapMail.

Napnix specialises in end-to-end digital product development for startups and enterprises. Founded in 2025, headquartered at 2519 Azad Nagar, Balongi, Sahibzada Ajit Singh Nagar (Mohali), Punjab 160055, India. Core expertise: React, Node.js, Flutter, AWS, AI/ML. Contact: info@napnix.in | +91 6239396615.

## Products

- [NapCRM](https://napnix.in/napcrm): Industry-specific CRM platform with lead management, e-commerce tools, automation, and multi-channel communication. $49/month (₹4,165) to $99/month (₹8,415), plus a custom Enterprise tier.
- [NapCRM Pricing](https://napnix.in/napcrm/pricing): Feature comparison across Starter, Growth, Business, Enterprise plans, with yearly discount options.
- [NapMail](https://napnix.in/napmail): Email marketing engine with smart SMTP rotation, anti-spam scoring, per-domain throttling, a visual automation builder, and NapCRM integration. Free plan available, then $8/month (₹699) to $59/month (₹4,999), plus a custom Enterprise tier.

## NapCRM Plans

- **Starter** — $49/month (₹4,165). 500 leads, 200 customers, 50 products, 2 team members, 1 GB storage.
- **Growth** — $79/month (₹6,715). 2,000 leads, 1,000 customers, 500 products, 5 team members, 5 GB storage.
- **Business** — $99/month (₹8,415). 10,000 leads, 5,000 customers, 2,000 products, 15 team members, 25 GB storage.
- **Enterprise** — Custom pricing. Unlimited leads, Unlimited customers, Unlimited products, Unlimited team members, Custom storage.

## Services

- [Custom Web Development](https://napnix.in/services/custom-web-development): Full-stack web applications — React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, cloud-native architectures.
- [Mobile App Development](https://napnix.in/services/mobile-app-development): iOS, Android and cross-platform apps using React Native and Flutter.
- [E-commerce Development](https://napnix.in/services/ecommerce-development): Shopify, WooCommerce, headless commerce and custom marketplace platforms.
- [Cloud Solutions](https://napnix.in/services/cloud-solutions): AWS, Azure and GCP infrastructure, DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, containerisation.
- [AI & Machine Learning](https://napnix.in/services/ai-machine-learning): Custom models, NLP, computer vision, predictive analytics and ML pipelines.

## Guides

- [Why Your Business Needs a PWA (And When It Does Not)](https://napnix.in/blog/why-business-needs-pwa): Progressive Web Apps install, work offline and skip app-store review. They also cannot do everything native can. Where the line actually falls in 2026. (updated 2026-10-05)
- [Monolith to Microservices: A Step-by-Step Migration Guide](https://napnix.in/blog/monolith-to-microservices): Decomposing a monolith without a rewrite. The strangler-fig sequence we use, in order, with the failure mode that kills most migrations at step four. (updated 2026-10-05)
- [Cost of Building a Custom CRM in 2026: A Complete Guide](https://napnix.in/blog/cost-of-custom-crm-2026): A custom CRM runs $30,000 to $250,000+ depending on scope. This is the full breakdown by tier, the hidden running costs, and the point where buying beats building. (updated 2026-10-05)
- [Top 10 AI Trends Shaping Global Business in 2026](https://napnix.in/blog/ai-trends-2026): Agentic AI moved from demo to production in 2026. Here are the ten shifts actually changing how enterprises build software, and what each one costs to adopt. (updated 2026-10-05)
- [React Native vs. Flutter in 2026: A Decision Guide](https://napnix.in/blog/react-native-vs-flutter): Both ship one codebase to iOS and Android. The real difference is hiring, rendering model and long-term maintenance — compared side by side, with a recommendation. (updated 2026-10-05)
